en: Black‑and‑white image showing a rural hotel building labeled "Bahnh‑Hôtel Bärenstein." The three‑story house with a balcony stands beside a dirt road, with trees, a wooden fence, and forested hills in the background. In front of the hotel are several people posed for the photograph: men in period suits or uniforms, women in long dresses and aprons, a bicycle, and a horse‑drawn cart. The scene appears staged as a formal view of the establishment, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
